experiment: C0-A structured source/transfer inference; limited C0-B identifiability audit
onset_grid: 0.5 to observed endpoint minus 0.25, step 0.05; no T1 supplied

models.M2: two explicit states with one shared tau learned from independent X only
models.M3: two explicit states with per-trajectory unknown tau, onset and positive amplitude profile likelihood

known_assumptions: one persistent positive hidden source step
linear observation drift, additive Gaussian process noise
no unmodelled pure transport dead time
effect gain normalized to 1; physical latent scale not identified
unknown_learned: normal AR coefficients and innovation variance from independent normal X
intervals: approximate 95% 1D profile likelihood intervals, 2deltaLL<=3.841; not Bayesian intervals; calibrated coverage evaluated
